cohort: 168 women with preterm premature rupture of membranes between 24 and 34 completed weeks of gestation
finding: Among women with preterm premature rupture of membranes between 24 and 34 completed weeks of gestation, substitution of azithromycin for erythromycin in the recommended antibiotic regimen did not affect latency or any other measured maternal or fetal outcomes.
